title: fix(plugin-grid): group-header labels read the object field's options only; the column `options` read is retired (objectui#11544)
body:
Fixes #11544

Clause-②: no

Retire, not widen (triage ruling `5966937083`): a grouped `object-grid` labels its group headers from the object field's `options` only. `ListColumnSchema` declares no `options` and is strict, so the column-level read honoured a key every publish refuses. Session `session_01FjqrwXPfSMkSfkKYDSRkN2`, branch `claude/issue-11544-group-header-field-options`.

## What changed

- `packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx`, `groupValueFormatter`: the label source `colOverride?.options || objectDefField?.options` is now `objectDefField?.options`. The column lookup stays, because it also supplies `type`, a declared `ListColumn` member (a `boolean` column respells `"true"` / `"false"` as Yes / No). The lookup is now typed as `ListColumn`, with the same `c is ListColumn` guard `maskedGroupingSignature` already uses, instead of `as any[]`. As a result, an undeclared column-member read at this site no longer compiles (proved below).
- `packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/gridGroupingMembers-8071.test.tsx`: the two cases that pinned `columns[].options` as behaviour are turned to pin the field's labels:
  - "the object field's `options` decide the header label, and a column `options` beside them is not read". It has three legs. The field's labels reach the header. A column carrying `options` beside the field's still shows the FIELD's labels. The same column with no field options shows the stored values.
  - "`order` sorts the RENDERED labels, so the field's options move the groups". This is `order: 'asc'` over the field's labels, with a no-field-labels control.
  - The header note ("pinned below AS BEHAVIOUR and reported as a finding") is rewritten to say the read is retired. `renderGrouped` now takes the host `objectFields` runtime prop, which is how field options reach an inline-rows grid without a schema read.
- `apps/console/src/__tests__/registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts`: the `object-grid.grouping` `pins` descriptor follows the fixture; it had said the read was pinned as behaviour and not repaired. This is the move PR #11540 made to its own descriptor. It is text only: nothing asserts on `pins` content.
- `.changeset/11544-group-header-field-options.md`: `@object-ui/plugin-grid` patch.

## Premise, measured on `origin/main` `d0c0c7fe9` (after PR #11554)

- `@objectstack/spec` 17.6.0 `ListColumnSchema` has fourteen keys (field, label, width, align, hidden, sortable, resizable, wrap, type, pinned, summary, prefix, link, action). `safeParse({ field, options })` answers `unrecognized_keys` naming `options`, and the control `{ field, type: 'select' }` parses.
- objectui `ObjectGridSchema.safeParse` with a column `options` answers `invalid_union` at `columns`, and the same grid with a column `type` parses.
- One read site. A grep for `.options` in `ObjectGrid.tsx` finds only the `groupValueFormatter` line reading it off a column; every other hit reads a field. A repo grep for the column-override lookup finds only this memo. Other `col.options` hits (`GridField`, `RecordPickerDialog`, the flow inspector) read different column schemas, not `ListColumn`, and none of them labels a group.
- In-repo producers of column `options`: none. The `options` spreads in app-shell build detail-form fields and import targets, not grid columns.
- PM hypothesis 1 ("the now-unused column lookup is removed if nothing else in the memo needs it") is half-falsified: `type` needs the lookup, so it stays, typed.

## Tests (HEAD `92bddae`)

- Fixture plus parity ledger: `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/gridGroupingMembers-8071.test.tsx apps/console/src/__tests__/registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts` gives `Test Files 2 passed (2)` and `Tests 265 passed (265)`.
- Whole package: `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-grid/` gives `Test Files 182 passed (182)` and `Tests 1691 passed (1691)`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-grid type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) exits 0. `--listFiles` on `tsconfig.test.json` lists the fixture once and `ObjectGrid.tsx` once.
- Dependency closure: `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/plugin-grid^...' build` exits 0.

## Ablation (one-shot, run from the committed fix through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode)

- **Behaviour.** Anchor `const rawOptions = objectDefField?.options;`, replaced with `const rawOptions = (colOverride as any)?.options || objectDefField?.options;` (anchor count 1 to 0, blob `004444984f55` to `316153fc4622`). Predicted: the label case goes red and everything else stays green. Observed: `Tests 1 failed | 9 passed (10)`, `expected [ 'Column Lost', 'Column Won' ] to deeply equal [ 'Closed Lost', 'Closed Won' ]`. Restore: blob equals HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- **Type.** The same anchor, replaced with `const rawOptions = colOverride?.options || objectDefField?.options;`. `tsc --noEmit` gives `error TS2339: Property 'options' does not exist on type` (the `ListColumn` object shape). Restore: blob equals HEAD.
- The `order` case stays green under the behaviour ablation by design. It carries no column `options`; it pins that `order` sorts the field's labels, which both trees do.

- `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`, `check-changeset-fixed.mjs` and `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs`: all report OK.
- `pnpm check:changeset-claims` is report-only. It names six pending changesets that mention `ObjectGrid.tsx` or the parity ledger. I re-read each paragraph, and none makes a claim about group-header labels or column `options`.
- `pnpm check:pending-changeset-literals`: `No test source names a pending changeset`.
- `pnpm check:test-path-roots`, `node scripts/check-vi-mock-specifiers.mjs`, `node scripts/check-vi-mock-inherit.mjs`, `pnpm check:spec-symbols` and `node scripts/check-type-check-coverage.mjs`: all report OK.

## Narrowings (declared)

- **Lint (CI-owned).** A narrowed run over the three changed source files. The population is from eslint's own config: `eslint --print-config` resolves all three, so none is ignored. `--format json` counts 3 files. `eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService`, so type-aware linting is off, and this diff cannot move an untouched file's verdict. In package form (inline config honoured, as `pnpm lint` runs it): 0 errors. In root `--no-inline-config` form: 1 error, `react-hooks/static-components`, at the annotated `AuthoredEmptyIcon` site. It is identical at BASE (BASE 1 error / 210 warnings, head 1 / 209).

## Acceptance notes

- The parity ledger's slice-17 history paragraph, which says the group-label memo reads `columns[].options`, is left as written. It records what that slice did, the way a changelog entry does. Only the live `pins` descriptor changed.
- No doc page or README described the column-options read (grep of `content/docs` and `packages/plugin-grid/README.md`), so there is no doc edit.
- The parity ledger is a shared file. This PR edits one string in its `object-grid.grouping` entry.
